text:
maya: RFC idea: add `X-Route-Subject` header so clients can explicitly indicate intended routing entity (project/tenant) when API key claims are ambiguous. Mostly for infra/service accounts.
devon: Is this just routing + metrics or does it touch billing/quotas?
maya: Start with routing + telemetry + soft quotas. Billing remains tied to the key's billing_account until org opts into route-subject-billing.
olga: Security: must validate header against key's allowed subjects. Suggest adding claim `can_route_as:[subjects]` or a per-key ACL. Otherwise it's privilege escalation.
billing-ree: For finance we need `resolved_subject`, `subject_overrode` in billing exports to reconcile charge attribution during migration.
maya: Example request: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: ApiKey sk_live_xxx" -H "X-Route-Subject: partners/acme/prod" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
devon: Gate behind feature flag `route-subject-v1` and start as opt-in per-org. Also add an audit-only header `X-Route-Subject-Audit` so clients can test without affecting routing.
olga: Audit events should include {"key_id":"K_123","attempted_subject":"partners/acme","decision":"allow|deny","remote_ip":"..."}. Auth path still p95 <30ms.
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: route-subject-v1 -> canary (5%) 2026-04-06T02:00Z.
maya: Rollout plan: 1) audit-only in staging 2) whitelisted orgs in canary 3) broader beta opt-in. Monitor metrics auth.denied_route_attempts, subject_override_rate, billing.mismatch_alerts.
devon: Rate-limiting: enforce per-key first, then coarse per-subject shaping to prevent metric cardinality explosion.
olga: Console UX: per-key toggle "Allow route-subject header" and recent override log for last 30 days. Admins can revoke.
maya: Action items: @devon implement gateway header parsing + auth check, @olga add audit events + SLO checks, @billing-ree add export fields and console toggle, I'll write RFC doc and copy for Console.
devon: Taking gateway + tests.
maya: Keep conservative defaults. Thanks!
